description: This is a shell script used for testing and demonstrating features of 'git diff --relative' functionality, including setup, checks for various diff outputs, and handling of external diff commands within a Git repository context.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Defines a function to verify the output of 'git diff' with specific expectations for relative paths.

methods.name: check_numstat
methods.description: Defines a function to verify the output of 'git diff --numstat' against expected results.

methods.name: check_stat
methods.description: Defines a function to verify the 'git diff --stat' output for a given file.

methods.name: check_raw
methods.description: Defines a function to verify the raw diff output from 'git diff --raw'.

methods.name: check_diff_relative_option
methods.description: Defines a function to test 'git diff' with the '--relative' option and specific relative path configurations.

methods.name: check_diff_no_relative_option
methods.description: Defines a function to test 'git diff' ignoring the '--relative' option, ensuring output matches expectations.
